releases.new: Use placeholders like load_id and boundary_timestamp in merge source_filter and destination_scope, so nested tables can prune destination partitions such as BigQuery ones when merging.
releases.breaking: Naive scd2 timestamps are no longer read as UTC, and drop_resources and pipeline.drop now drop all resource tables; check scd2 timestamps, and old jira and salesforce sources were rewritten.

releases.new: Load full snapshots with the new cdc merge strategy, which upserts rows and deletes destination rows missing from the snapshot, across many destinations.
releases.breaking: Pendulum 3 or newer is now required and unofficial pendulum helpers in dlt.common.time are removed; also changed: filesystem timestamps, cursor types, JSON datetimes, Snowflake timestamps. Update code.

releases.new: Join datasets that live on different destinations, such as DuckDB and S3 filesystem, in a single query through the dataset table join API.
releases.breaking: Failed load packages no longer auto-abort and now retry, raising LoadClientJobTerminalRetry; filesystem layouts without ext now append extensions and table prefixes keep a trailing separator, changing file names.

releases.new: Declare runner instance requirements for jobs via require.instance, an open dictionary such as size medium, replacing the now-deprecated machine key.
Use the staging-optimized replace strategy on ClickHouse for atomic table swaps, so a full replace never leaves the destination half-loaded.
Use merge write disposition with the SQLAlchemy destination, and use incremental scd2 with a merge key.
Use SQLAlchemy destinations with staging datasets, pass a custom session to the REST API source, and add DltResource objects to the REST API config.
Use the rest_api, sql_database and filesystem sources directly from dlt core, plus a new SQLAlchemy destination and SFTP support for the filesystem source.
releases.breaking: Major release: foreign_key hint is dropped in favor of nested references, the complex data type is deprecated for json, and terminal job errors now abort the load package; review the linked breaking changes list.

releases.new: Use partitioning and schema evolution with merge on delta tables, and set custom valid-from and valid-to values for scd2 records.
Load jobs now start continuously as loader slots free up, and a new get_delta_tables helper lets you optimize and vacuum Delta tables.
